We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list). We need to choose one that can be further processed with next template 1914389, then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We attempted applying 1914389 to one of the precursors (the one with silyl protecting group). It gave two products: a precursor and a side product? The result tuple: (('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C', 'CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC'),). So applying 1914389 to the first precursor gave two fragments: the main fragment (still with silyl) and a side fragment (an ester with phosphonate). That seems like a disconnection.

Now we need to apply 1914390 to the appropriate fragment(s). We tried applying 1914390 to the first fragment (the silyl-containing) but got no result. Also tried on the side fragment, no result.

Maybe we need to choose a different precursor from the first step. The first step gave three possible precursors:

1. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C' (both ends silyl protected)
2. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO' (one silyl)
3. 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C' (maybe no silyl)

Actually third is 'C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C' which is simpler.

We need to apply template 1914389 to the chosen precursor. The template likely does a protection removal? Not sure.

Let's try applying 1914389 to the third precursor (no silyl).
